entries.title: PaybackTime 2

discovery_sources.notes: Repository describes the game as later released into the public domain with source code. Obtain and preserve the original author statement and inspect every file before acquisition.
Reports full version and source released by the authors; secondary corroboration only.

restrictions: Verify original author declaration and scope; repository-level statement is not yet independently authenticated.
Confirm all bundled art, maps, music and sound are included in the author grant.
Identify composer and verify music/sound scope before reuse.
Do not assume title or logos are included in public-domain statement.

remake_plan.notes: Turn-based squad tactics, up to four players, editable maps/weapons/items and persistent teams. Strong remake candidate after original grant and component scope are verified.

entries.reviewer_notes: Promising lead; do not download/reuse until primary author grant and complete component scope are captured.

entries.title: Duelyst

discovery_sources.notes: Repository identifies original 2016 game, shutdown-era snapshot, local hosting and CC0-1.0. Confirm upstream rights-holder grant and any excluded dependencies before acquisition.

restrictions: Audit bundled third-party libraries and dependencies individually.
Confirm original rights-holder scope and check every asset for third-party exclusions.
Verify music and audio provenance separately.
Duelyst name, logos and marks are not presumed CC0.
Audit Firebase, fonts, packages and bundled libraries.

territories: Worldwide (CC0 scope subject to third-party rights)

remake_plan.notes: Digital collectible card game plus tactical grid combat. Candidate for a modern Streamiov edition; first verify all source/assets and any excluded third-party materials.

entries.reviewer_notes: Strong lead. The repository states CC0, but the catalogue intentionally does not mark the complete title as fully cleared until all component provenance is checked.

entries.title: Glitch

discovery_sources.notes: Client repository says all included files are CC0 1.0 and expressly excludes Glitch logo and trademark.
Location art and source repository explicitly states CC0.
Overlay art/source explicitly CC0; logo and trademark excluded.

restrictions: Only files in the released client repositories; do not infer that the complete server/backend or full original game is included.
Only files included in the specific Tiny Speck repositories; preserve repository and file-level provenance.
Verify each character asset is within the original CC0 grant and not a third-party item.
Original repository expressly excludes the Glitch logo and trademark. Do not use original branding.

territories: Worldwide (CC0 scope subject to exclusions and third-party rights)

remake_plan.notes: Shutdown-era creative browser MMO. Excellent candidate to study and selectively reuse the explicitly CC0 art/client files; a full MMO reconstruction needs a new backend and original Streamiov identity.

entries.reviewer_notes: Do not describe the complete original game as CC0. The grant applies to specified released repositories/files only.

entries.title: SCP - Containment Breach

discovery_sources.notes: Repository README declares game and source code CC BY-SA 3.0; the work is based on SCP Foundation community works.
CC BY-SA 3.0 permits sharing/adaptation subject to attribution and share-alike conditions; not public domain.

restrictions: Confirm repository scope and dependencies.
Check asset provenance, credits and any separately licensed third-party materials.

components.license_name: CC BY-SA 3.0 and upstream SCP licences
restrictions: SCP Foundation source works and identifiers require separate licence/attribution review.
Do not presume the SCP name, logos or marks are cleared for Streamiov branding.

territories: Worldwide (subject to CC BY-SA and upstream SCP terms)

remake_plan.notes: 3D survival-horror game. A remake would need attribution and share-alike compliance plus separate review of SCP Foundation works and third-party assets.
blocked_components: upstream SCP content pending licence audit

entries.reviewer_notes: This is openly licensed, not a lapsed-copyright/public-domain title. Include only if Streamiov accepts CC BY-SA obligations.

entries.title: Machines: Wired for War

discovery_sources.notes: Repository says the GL port source was released as free software under permission of Night Dive Studios, current rights holder.

discovery_sources.source_type: community fork and asset acquisition instructions
discovery_sources.notes: Community fork identifies separate downloadable game assets; verify the rights basis and exact scope for those assets directly with Nightdive before redistribution or derivative work.

restrictions: Preserve GPL notices and confirm rights-holder permission covers intended commercial modification and distribution.
Assets are distributed separately; no clear redistributable licence established in current research.
Verify music/sound rights and scope.
Verify game title/logo use separately.

remake_plan.notes: 1999 3D real-time strategy game; technically interesting revival candidate. Do not copy/redistribute assets or market a remake until Nightdive permission and all component rights are confirmed.

entries.reviewer_notes: Code appears permissively available under GPL-3.0 with rights-holder permission, but the game as a whole is not yet cleared.
